full_page.content:
1947, March 28
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
March 28th 1947.
Mr. J. J. O'Donnell 1120 Lake Shore Drive Chicago, Ills.
St. Felix Friary Route 8 Huntington, Indiana
Blessed be God in all His disigns! God bless you Mr. O'Donnell-
Mr. J.J. O'Donnell Nargill Texas.
You and yours.
Many thanks from myself and our whole community for your generous donation of fruit received in perfect condition, - two fine big eratis shiped March 17th (Irish holy-day! ), and four fine baskets March 22nd.
May our dear Lord bless yourself - as also everyone who in any way has been interested. ... . What a privilege to do a favor for God in doing for our neighbor! The same too can be said of being appreciative and grateful for such favor - Communion of saints.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
